test_commands.purpose: Run unit tests for all packages
Run unit tests with the Go race detector enabled
Run go vet static analysis on all packages
Verify module graph and ensure go.mod/go.sum are tidy and committed
Run fuzz targets (10s each) against policy, cert signing, config loading, and log redaction
End-to-end smoke test against a real AWS target environment

deployment_steps.description: Create a new asymmetric signing key in AWS KMS (ECC_NIST_P256 or RSA_4096) that will serve as the CA private key. Record the key ARN.
deployment_steps.rollback: Delete or disable the KMS key if provisioning fails before any certificates are issued.

deployment_steps.description: Run `terraform apply` in the deploy/terraform/ directory to provision the Lambda function, IAM roles, and KMS key policies.
deployment_steps.rollback: Run `terraform destroy` or revert to the previous Terraform state snapshot.

deployment_steps.description: Set Lambda environment variables: GOBLESS_CA_KMS_KEY_ID, GOBLESS_CA_MAX_TTL, GOBLESS_PRINCIPAL_ALLOWED, and any policy overrides documented in RUNBOOKS.md.
deployment_steps.rollback: Restore previous environment variable values via the AWS console or CLI.

deployment_steps.description: Invoke the Lambda function with a test signing request and verify a valid SSH certificate is returned and passes `ssh-keygen -L` inspection.

Create a new KMS key, update the Lambda environment variable (GOBLESS_CA_KMS_KEY_ID), re-verify cert issuance, then schedule deletion of the old KMS key after the maximum certificate validity window expires.
deployment_steps.rollback: Revert the Lambda GOBLESS_CA_KMS_KEY_ID environment variable to the previous key ARN.

deployment_steps.description: If the CA key is compromised: immediately disable the KMS key, update Lambda to refuse signing (set a deny policy), notify all users to re-authenticate with fresh certificates, and follow the incident runbook in RUNBOOKS.md.
deployment_steps.rollback: Restore service only after a new CA key is generated and verified (see rotate_ca_key step).
